name: Edsby
description_en:
Edsby is a K–12 platform combining assessment, learning records, family communication and organization-wide analytics. Its roles include teachers, students, guardians and district administrators.

It is an institution-managed service: the school or district creates accounts and determines access. A parent cannot assume that signing up independently will expose a child’s school records.
description_zh:
Edsby 是 K–12 平台，结合考核、学习记录、家校沟通和跨机构分析，角色包括教师、学生、监护人与学区管理员。

它由机构管理：学校或学区创建账户并决定访问权限。家长不能假定独立注册就能看到孩子的学校记录。

core_features.explanation_en: Organize grades, standards or competencies and learner evidence.
core_features.explanation_zh: 组织成绩、标准或能力及学习证据。

core_features.explanation_en: Institution-managed guardian access connects families with school information.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过机构管理的监护人权限关联家庭和学校信息。

core_features.explanation_en: School workflows include digital forms and approval routing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 学校工作流包含数字表单及审批路由。

zh: 示例：把考核证据关联到家庭可见信息

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_zh: 考核、家校沟通与工作流
sections.en: The current platform describes gradebooks, standards/competencies and evidence, news and messages, student analytics, forms/approvals and conference scheduling. Destinations is a named competency-based assessment/reporting capability. These features address school-wide operations rather than just distributing course videos; which modules are procured and enabled requires an institutional scope.
sections.zh: 当前平台介绍成绩簿、标准及能力证据、新闻与消息、学生分析、表单审批和家长会安排。Destinations 是有名称的能力本位考核及报告能力。这些功能涉及全校流程，而不仅是分发课程视频；采购和启用哪些模块需按机构明确。

sections.title_en: Example: link assessment evidence to family visibility
sections.title_zh: 示例：把考核证据关联到家庭可见信息
sections.en: An illustrative pilot starts with a class, an assessment and a teacher-entered evidence item. Verify the teacher view, the student view and two guardian accounts with different relationships before sharing the record broadly. Check how a corrected assessment appears and who can see it. This is a suggested access and learning-record check, not an implemented Edsby deployment.
sections.zh: 试点可从一个班级、一项考核和教师录入的证据开始。在广泛分享前，分别检查教师、学生和具有不同关系的两个监护人账户。还应确认修改后的考核如何呈现、谁能看到。这是建议的权限与学习记录检查，并非本文实施的部署。

sections.title_en: Institutional sales, no verified public rate
sections.title_zh: 机构采购，未核实公开费率
sections.en: The linked official sales form addresses K–12 education organizations and separately redirects existing student, parent and teacher users to help. It does not publish an amount, learner meter or term in the retrieved text. Leave those fields unknown and request a proposal for the institution, modules, SIS/identity connections, migration and support. A support account or guardian login is not a free procurement plan.
sections.zh: 官方销售表单面向 K–12 教育机构，并把现有学生、家长及教师引向支持入口。读取文本没有金额、学员计量或合同周期，应保持未知，按机构、模块、SIS 与身份连接、迁移及支持询问方案。支持账户或家长登录不是免费采购套餐。

sections.title_en: Use the school support chain and protect role boundaries
sections.title_zh: 按学校支持链路处理并验证角色边界
sections.en: The homepage says students ask teachers or school offices, parents ask school offices, and teachers use their district help desk; designated representatives escalate unresolved issues. Establish those contacts before rollout and test account/class synchronization. Edsby is relevant to K–12 institutional learning and family engagement, while a commercial course storefront has different needs. Source licensing, deployment options, contractual retention and backup restoration were not verified.
sections.zh: 首页说明学生向教师或学校办公室求助，家长向学校办公室求助，教师使用学区帮助台，由指定代表升级未解决问题。推广前需建立这些联系人并测试账户与班级同步。它适合 K–12 机构学习和家校沟通，商业课程店面的需求则不同。源码许可、部署选项、合同保留期限和备份恢复未核实。
